mapping.draft_py:
# Offer Immortality: "Target creature gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn."
# Two GRANT_ABILITY atoms in printed keyword order (M21 Heroic Intervention's "gain hexproof and
# indestructible" shape), each until end of turn, over one target creature: the same TARGET
# selector in both, one target slot (M21 Sure Strike's "gets +3/+0 and gains first strike").
target = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Seq(steps=(
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.DEATHTOUCH),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': target,
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.INDESTRUCTIBLE),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': target,
            }),
        )),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Target creature gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.

mapping.notes: Two GRANT_ABILITY (DEATHTOUCH, INDESTRUCTIBLE) until end of turn in printed order (Heroic Intervention's two-keyword shape) over one TARGET selector, one slot (Sure Strike).
